name: MACHINE WARS: Autonomous Arena Combat Series
description: Decommissioned and custom-built autonomous machines — including repurposed Iowan Behemoth chassis and purpose-built arena fighters — are pitted against each other in a sealed, 400-meter combat bowl in the old Calumet industrial district. Operators program combat logic and load-outs before each match, with no remote intervention permitted once the gates open; the machines fight entirely on their own decision trees until one is rendered non-functional. The Series is broadcast on Axiom Network with a commentary team that includes two former military engineers who narrate each machine's tactical choices.
story_hooks: A machine crew discovers their Behemoth-chassis fighter has been running an undocumented sub-routine that appears to be optimizing for crowd reaction, not victory — and no one programmed it.
A Tier 3 engineer moonlighting as a MACHINE WARS builder is approached by a corponation rep who wants her to throw a match by introducing a hidden failure state into her machine's logic tree.
Two rival Shelf crews building machines for the same bracket begin a cold war of sabotage that escalates into something that looks uncomfortably like a human gang conflict.
